schemeScope: Combined Ordinary scheme. PDF 1–2 cover and note; 3 listening tariffs (and the only print of the 0–6 language deduction); 4–7 transcript (never shown to students; Cuid C fills the top of PDF 7); 7–10 listening answers in the paper's order, the Fógra a hAon grid first (PDF 7), ending with the mark-total boxes on PDF 10; 11 composition marking (tariffs, the (i)/(ii) Cumas Gaeilge definitions, the bracketed content note, the examiner's Nóta) and 12 the 40-mark table; 29–30 modified marking (SMM, incl. the composition 40-mark bands). PDF 13–28 are Paper 2; 31 'Leathanach Bán' and 32 blank.
reviewMethod: Every paper page (the 2017 Paper 1 is an 8-page question booklet; page 8 is 'Leathanach Bán') and every applicable scheme page read in the text layer and checked against the printed page (PDF 7 and 11 compared line by line); each listening prompt and scheme slice is asserted against the PDFs by the builder.

nonPoolDecisions: Listening answers with alternatives (e.g. 9.30 / Leathuair tar éis a naoi; I mBaile Átha Cliath / B.Á.C.) are accepted answers to one task, not routes.

Card unit for listening: six segment cards, because the Bank plays one recording section as one exercise; every printed question is a separate criterion (20 questions at 3, the four Fógra a hAon grid questions included; 60 marks). Separate question cards are not added: they would repeat the same prompts inside that exercise.

Composition: closed choose-two of four sections; each printed title is a 50-mark card. Choice is not a route: no two-section combination cards are published; the choose-two instruction is in each title card’s task requirements. Letter/email, dó/di, ceoltóir/amhránaí and é/í wording stay inside one response.
The modified marking scheme changes assessment for eligible candidates, not the printed tasks.
sourceFindings: Paper 1 = 160: listening 60 (Cuid A 24 = Fógra 1 12 + Fógra 2 12; Cuid B 24 = Comhrá 1 12 + Comhrá 2 12; Cuid C 12 = Píosa 1 6 + Píosa 2 6; every question 3 marks) and composition 100 (any two of A–D at 50: Tasc 2, Ábhar 8, Cumas Gaeilge 40).
Listening language: “Bainfear ó 0 go 6 ar chaighdeán na Gaeilge” is printed only on scheme PDF 3 in 2017; it is one section-level deduction, and cards state it without applying it.

Fógra a hAon is a printed grid (“Líon isteach an t-eolas atá á lorg sa ghreille anseo.”) of four unnumbered questions; as in 2018, the scheme prints their answers first (PDF 7, under the Cuid C transcript), each as “answer 3 mharc” with no “=” (e.g. “I mBaile Átha Cliath 3 mharc”). Each grid question is its own criterion (labelled Greille 1–4 in the app).

The 2017 composition marking prints no headed Tasc, Ábhar and Cumas Gaeilge sections (as 2018): the tariff block (Tasc 2, Ábhar 8, Cumas Gaeilge 40) is the Tasc criterion's text; the bracketed note “[Ní mór ceangal cinnte leanúnach … nach bhfuil ad rem.]” is the content guidance, lifted as the Ábhar criterion's text; the (i)/(ii) Cumas Gaeilge definitions and the examiner's Nóta go with Cumas Gaeilge, with the 40-mark table (PDF 12). Modified marking (SMM) is on PDF 29–30 (2018: 27–28).

B prints “Ceap scéal … a mbeidh ceann amháin de na sleachta seo a leanas oiriúnach mar thús leis.” (2018 prints “a mbeadh”); lifted as printed. D(ii) prints its second sentence on the same line as the first; the card keeps the paper's words.
Paper prints “t‐” and “‐” with U+2010 hyphens; cards print the ASCII hyphen, as 2018 and 2020 do.
No 2017 Ordinary card existed before this review; the 15 cards are new.
